title: Template lesson

story.title: A shelf of numbers
story.summary: You read numbers off a row, one by index.

uses.title: Spreadsheets
uses.body: Rows of cells are read by position.

uses.title: Image pixels
uses.body: A picture is a grid read by coordinates.

uses.title: Game boards
uses.body: Squares are looked up by index.

whenNot: Skip it when the row must grow or shrink often.

outcomes.read-an-array: Read an element of an array by its index

the-problem.title: Finding one number
the-problem.caption: You have a row of numbers, an [[array]], and need the second one. Scanning from the start feels slow.

how-it-works.title: Jump straight to it
how-it-works.caption: An array stores its cells side by side, so the index tells you exactly where to look.
how-it-works.keyIdea: The index tells you exactly where to look.

which-index.prompt: Which index holds the highlighted number?
which-index.explanation: Indexes start at 0, so the second cell has index 1.

array.gloss: A row of cells stored side by side and read by index.
